item.title: High stakes as Fed Chair Kevin Warsh prepares for first major speech
item.description: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is set to deliver a key speech on Friday at the annual Jackson Hole gathering of economists and central bankers, with high expectations.

item.title: Trump orders federal government to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America
item.description: President Trump signed an executive order on Thursday directing the federal government to rename Lake Ontario, amid an escalating trade dispute with Canada.

item.title: Meta agrees to $17B settlement; nuclear regulator to drop radiation safety rule
item.description: Meta and the states that sued it have reached a $17 billion settlement. Meanwhile, nuclear regulators plan to abandon a decades-old radiation safety rule.

item.title: Ratko Mladic, former Bosnian Serb commander behind wartime atrocities, dies at 84
item.description: Ratko Mladic, a key figure in the 1990s Bosnian war that claimed over 100,000 lives, has died. He ordered troops to 'scorch the brain...'
